component.name: Diti
component.summary: Cross-platform daily planning and multi-phase routine timer

description.p: Diti is a multi-phase productivity timer and daily routine tracker designed for deep focus and session management.

ul.li: Multi-phase routines with custom prep, work, and rest intervals
Local session history and analytics breakdown
Adaptive notification permission handling and desktop audio chimes

description.p: Production release with complete cross-platform support.
